_comment: Hand-curated mapping from Allternit catalog connector ids (keys) to open-connector provider ids (values). Generated by comparing cmd/allternit-api/assets/open-design/connectors.json against services/open-connector/catalog/apps/*.json (displayName + homepageUrl) to confirm each pair refers to the same real service. Only services genuinely present in the vendored open-connector catalog are listed; unmapped Allternit ids remain connectable:false honestly. Do not auto-generate or pattern-match this file.
